title: Melting Eye of Consciousness
description: A large stylized eye with a teal iris and ornate mandala pattern drips white liquid from its cracked sclera against a black background. Below it, a fragmented green humanoid figure lies broken and melting into a purple puddle, with newspaper clippings bearing the repeated text 'TOTAL' across its torso, surrounded by floating bubbles and vines.
prompt: surreal painting on black background featuring a massive cracked eye at the top with white paint dripping down, the iris is teal with intricate orange and green mandala patterns and a black pupil with white highlight. Below, a broken abstract humanoid figure in shades of green and geometric fragments lies melting into a purple puddle, newspaper strips with the text TOTAL visible on its body, transparent bubbles containing small symbols float upwards connected by white vines, psychedelic dripping paint aesthetic.
